CustomerProfile.title: Customer
CustomerProfile.itemCount: {count, plural, =0 {No items} one {# item} other {# items}}
CustomerProfile.orderCount: {count, plural, =0 {No delivered orders} one {# delivered order} other {# delivered orders}}
CustomerProfile.currencyScope: Metrics in {currency}; other currencies are not combined.
CustomerProfile.rfmExplanation: Recency: days since the last delivered order. Frequency: delivered order count. Monetary: their total less recorded same-currency refunds, including tax and shipping. These are rule-based segments, not population percentiles; monetary value does not determine the segment.

segmentRules.champion: at least 5 delivered orders and at most 60 days since the last
segmentRules.loyal: at least 3 delivered orders and at most 90 days since the last
segmentRules.potential: purchasing history without another matching rule
segmentRules.new: one delivered order within the last 30 days
segmentRules.at_risk: recency exceeds 2.5 times the average purchase cycle
segmentRules.hibernating: 121 to 300 days since the last delivered order
segmentRules.inactive: more than 300 days since the last delivered order
segmentRules.unknown: no delivered orders in the selected currency

CustomerProfile.churnExplanation: Requires at least 3 delivered orders and a positive purchase cycle. High: over 150 days. Medium: over 90 days or twice the usual cycle. Otherwise low. This is a heuristic, not a probability.
CustomerProfile.activityWindow: {count, plural, one {# latest tracked event} other {# latest tracked events}}; not all-time totals.
